Name: Crops Survive Season Change
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod installed, crops that are planted in the right season will not die when the season changes.

By default, crops die in winter as normal. This can be disabled in the config.

By default regrowable crops do not survive season changes when they would normally die. This can be disabled in the config.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
